# M/s Endorys (ENDORYS™)

> Bengaluru-based medical-device and acoustic metrology research initiative developing conformable quantitative ultrasound architectures, impedance-matched acoustic coupling (~1.50 MRayl), and closed-loop Coupling Quality Index (CQI) gating for repeatable tissue and non-destructive testing (NDT) measurements.

## Core Identifiers & Intellectual Property
- **Legal Entity:** M/s Endorys (Micro Enterprise, Udyam Registration: `UDYAM-KR-03-0786660`, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India)
- **Founder & Principal Inventor:** Sadhu Shobab Bollipo — ORCID: `0009-0006-7846-7884` (`https://orcid.org`)
- **Patent Status:** Patent Pending — Indian Provisional Patent Application No. `202641134091` (Priority Date: 07 November 2026)
- **Open-Science Benchmark Archive:** Zenodo `DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24555614` (`https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24555614`)
- **Open-Source Reference Repository:** GitHub `Endorys/platform` (`https://github.com/Endorys/platform`) — Apache-2.0 software / CC-BY-4.0 docs; hardware & closed-loop CQI gating patent rights reserved

## Site Map & Technical Resources
- **Home:** `https://endorys.com` — Core measurement challenge, 3-layer platform architecture (Endorys Matrix, Controlled Acquisition, Endorys Insight), and Protocol E001 overview.
- **Interactive CQI Simulator:** `https://endorys.comcheck.html` — Multi-parameter 1.7 MHz curved-surface acoustic coupling simulator, Clinical Repeatability (CV%) ROI estimator, and client-side CSV waveform auditor.
- **Technology:** `https://endorys.comtechnology.html` — Conformal sensing geometry, coupling drift suppression, and path qualification methodology.
- **Applications:** `https://endorys.comapplications.html` — Quantitative tissue characterization and curved-surface industrial non-destructive testing (NDT) research tracks.
- **Research Library:** `https://endorys.comresearch-library.html` — Twelve structured research workstreams, Protocol E001 validation gates, and selective openness policy.
- **Venture Overview:** `https://endorys.comoverview.html` — Governance, IP posture, and collaboration framework.
